name: Mikiko
role: "AmenXL Mikiko", captain of the Xeno Warriors, demigod, reincarnation of Xeno, Corrupted soul / C-soul, Orenji clan; Fox Girl's first apprentice; ally.
appearance: Red hair (Technica: "that red haired one", Ep 25). Lost his fox tail when reincarnated, so he is no longer half fox (Ep 22). Wears a red bracelet that appeared when he was reincarnated; it holds the antivirus and blows up after the Ultima fight, leaving burns on his hand (Ep 19, 25). Eyes glow orange when using True empathy (Ep 13).

forms.name: Fox King mode
forms.note: Main power-up; has a time limit and runs out (Ep 13, 25). Also lets him smell things from far away (Ep 14, 22). Kaeru says it can't work at full power since he is no longer a Fox (Ep 22).

forms.name: Corrupted form
forms.note: Darkness surrounds him and he transforms after Ultima taunts him about Kitsune (Ep 20). Overpowers Ultima at 25%, sees invisible Kyle, makes a dark blade; his heart stops and he dies briefly (Ep 21-22).

skills.name: Fire Blitz
skills.description: Shoots fire at the enemy (Fire element).

skills.name: Blazing Wind
skills.description: Wind and fire wrap around the enemy, cutting off air and burning them; costs a lot of Karma.

skills.name: Xeno Blast
skills.description: Combined energy blast with Rhalix. In Ep 18 Mikiko's alone hits about 50% of Ultima's strength. Uses up a lot of energy.

skills.name: True empathy
skills.description: Orenji clan power: reads the opponent's emotions and copies any of their attacks his body can physically do; eyes glow orange. Overuse causes 'withdrawals' where he loses control of his emotions (Ep 25).

skills.name: HekuBlade scatter
skills.description: Surrounds the enemy with blades.

skills.name: Hekubarrier
skills.description: Makes a barrier out of the scattered blades; Fox Girl made the blade so it's very hard to break.

skills.name: Heku
skills.description: Summons the Hekublade; used to send souls inside it. After Kaeru returns, the blade's form changes to match the holder's soul (Ep 22).

skills.name: Netsu
skills.description: Speed burst; he can hold it about 30 seconds (Ep 13).

skills.name: Netsu Burst
skills.description: Full Netsu; his body goes on fire. Can be cast on someone else: used on Rhalix to escape Ultima (it gave Rhalix 3rd degree burns) and to hold Ultima down.

skills.name: Wind flight
skills.description: Flies using his Wind element; Rhalix trains him in the air.

skills.name: Soul Splitter
skills.description: Technique Master Yo taught: sends a copy of your soul to attack, which enemies who can't see souls won't see coming. Safer for him because he has a C-soul.

skills.name: Karma activation
skills.description: Unleashing Karma inside someone's soul to start their Karma flowing; can kill the target. Offered to Yuri with Rhalix.

skills.name: Manifest Greatness
skills.description: Cross arms in an X, imagine handcuffs, break out while saying it; frees you from bad thoughts (taught to Yuri, Ep 22 flashback). Makes him glow red (Ep 25).

skills.name: Kaeru!
skills.description: Calls Kaeru out of the Hekublade; she lands on him.

skills.name: Dark blade
skills.description: Makes a dark blade in his corrupted form.

skills.name: Corrupted Karma blast
skills.description: Blasts with corrupted Karma (phased through invisible Kyle).

skills.name: Seeing invisible enemies
skills.description: In corrupted form he can see Kyle while Kyle is invisible.

skills.name: Wing eating
skills.description: Eats Technica's ripped-off Skylander wings; it heals him and raises his Karma.

weapons: Red bracelet with Yuri's antivirus (broken in Ep 25)
relationships: Rhalix — fellow Xeno Warrior and friendly rival
Yuri Tenjo — trainer/ally; calls her "Little Yuri"; she has a crush on him
Kaeru — Hekublade's guardian; calls him Mikiko Senpai
Ultima — enemy he saves with the antivirus
Master Yo — taught him Soul splitter
key_quote: True strength is the weak that overcomes the strong and finds a way through.

name: Rhalix
role: Rhalix Murasaki, demigod Skylander, captain of the Sky Patrol (SP); ex Royal Knight who was banished; memory chaser; ally.
appearance: Wings he can retract (Ep 13); wings burned by Netsu Burst (Ep 14). Lunar form: Karma goes from purple to silver, eyes become crescent moons, several moons on his body, gray light (Ep 23).

forms.name: Lunar form
forms.note: Unlocked by meditating at night and passing three fear trials set by the first Skylander with the moon element. He is at the form's peak and calmer in it. Runs out in Ep 25.

skills.name: Kishi
skills.description: Gravity power. Slows Mikiko down (Ep 14), slows and drops Ultima's blasts (Ep 25), carries Ultima (Ep 25).

skills.name: Xeno Blast
skills.description: Combined blast with Mikiko.

skills.name: Wing retraction
skills.description: Pulls his wings in to escape a grab and to let burned wings heal.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies; teaches Mikiko to fight in the air.

skills.name: Karma activation
skills.description: "KARMA ACTIVATION!" Used on Zane, who already had Karma.

skills.name: Soul Splitter
skills.description: Sends a soul copy that hits Ultima unseen until Ultima's sky tech senses it.

skills.name: Moon reflect
skills.description: Reflects attacks; costs a good amount of Karma.

skills.name: Moon Fall
skills.description: Drops his moon; costs a lot of Karma. Usually an attack, used here to save Mikiko.

skills.name: Roof blast
skills.description: Shoots a hole in the roof to reveal the moon before going Lunar.

skills.name: Healing
skills.description: Heals Sam, Sintrie and Mikiko after the Ultima fight.

relationships: Lexy — SP member taken by SR
Kyrie — ally; she thinks he's cute asleep
Hannah (Gov girl) — he threatened, then promised to protect her
Ai Oni — once took him over
First moon Skylander — his Lunar form mentor
key_quote: Saving you was the goal, not winning the fight.
clan: Murasaki (name given to the highest Royal knights)

name: Yuri Tenjo
role: Genius ex-C1 Government tech, Ultima's little sister; builds the antivirus and trains Mikiko and Rhalix at her HQ; ally.
appearance: Age 14 at F2 (Ep 16). Rhalix calls her "pretty green" like her brother (Ep 14).

skills.name: Hacking
skills.description: Hacks Government security cameras and sees live feeds.

skills.name: VR room
skills.description: Advanced VR with an exact Ultima replica at set power % that simulates pain.

skills.name: Ultima-pinning fight form
skills.description: Lock your feet, don't look at his eyes, attack. Pins VR Ultima at 50%.

skills.name: Yuri Bomb
skills.description: Homemade bomb thrown to save Minta.

skills.name: Heat wave decoy
skills.description: Turns an air conditioner/heater up full to throw off heat scanners.

skills.name: Invention
skills.description: Antivirus, communicators, healing pods; upgraded Ultima with sky tech.

skills.name: Karma control
skills.description: Starts learning Karma while building the antivirus.

relationships: Gracie, Euphoria — C1 coworkers who tried to befriend her
Mikiko — crush; wants to join his Freedom Fighters
key_quote: God loves us.

name: Ultima
role: Aniri Tenjo, Project Ultima, the Government's "Ultimate Weapon". Controlled by Kyle's virus and set on killing the Government ("Golden path"); freed by the antivirus in Ep 25.

forms.name: Power output %
forms.note: Fights at set percentages and needs time to ramp up (25% to 45% to 70% to 100% output).

skills.name: Attack prediction
skills.description: Computer chip reads fighting habits, exhaustion, fear and heart rate to predict attacks.

skills.name: Endless stamina
skills.description: Can fight for weeks or years without breaks.

skills.name: Blasts
skills.description: Fires energy blasts, including many at once.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies after Rhalix and Mikiko.

skills.name: Facility walls
skills.description: Controls Government facilities and raises a wall powered by cores.

skills.name: Living weapon body
skills.description: Every part of his body is a weapon and a shield; survives bombs inside him; heals faster than demigods.

skills.name: Sky tech sixth sense
skills.description: Senses unseen things like Soul Splitter copies.

skills.name: 100% output
skills.description: Full power; breaks Rhalix's ribs.

relationships: Kyle — controlled him with a virus; brief 'business partner'
Mikiko, Rhalix — enemies who save him
key_quote: This is my Golden path.
note: Has no Karma control. Kyle says he took Ultima's KA (Ep 24). Down to 5% power after Ep 25.

name: Sintrie (Max)
role: SP vice captain; ex Government C3 Tech Squad, the only Skylander there; lost his memories; wanted for killing Royals; ally.
appearance: White hair, big smoker. Has wings.

skills.name: Vampire cut
skills.description: Knife cut that keeps draining blood while healing his own wounds; also stops the target moving.

skills.name: Healing potions
skills.description: Makes healing potions for the team.

skills.name: Wing rip
skills.description: Rips off Technica's wings, the most painful thing you can do to a Skylander.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies with his wings.

relationships: Technica — best friend/love from 5 years ago
Kyle — old coworker; bound him with the Kyle phone deal
Kyrie — gives him 2 years to save her mom or she turns him in
key_quote: You don't disrespect the SP!

name: Sam
role: "Skylander Sam", SP member; kicked off his sky island; ally.

skills.name: Psychotic time bomb
skills.description: Bat throw that puts a bomb mark over the target and freezes them; bombs go off inside after a few seconds. Doesn't need a direct hit.

skills.name: TTB
skills.description: Named in Ep 23 ("one hit from my TTB and you're out of here").

relationships: Zane — opponent he walks away from
key_quote: TIME TO BEAT SOME HEADS!

name: Kyle
role: Lieutenant Kyle of C2 (human modifications); made the virus that controls Ultima; killed Minta, Gracie and Euphoria; main villain of the season.

forms.name: Attack Mode
forms.note: Activates and suddenly gets much stronger (Ep 16).

skills.name: Speed modification
skills.description: Human speed modification; steals the Hekublade.

skills.name: Invisibility / invincibility
skills.description: Invisible, and attacks phase through him; wears off the more he's hit.

skills.name: Kyle phone
skills.description: Anyone who tells Sintrie their real name gets it swapped for 'Kyle' (Minta's name comes out as Kyle).

skills.name: KA steal
skills.description: His KA: steals KAs by touch, even unawakened ones. Holds over 10,000, including Ultima's. Makes his own Karma impossible to sense.

skills.name: Clone Clone
skills.description: Makes Kyle clones that split in two when cut.

skills.name: Mind-control chip
skills.description: Controls Technica with a chip and modes (defense/passive/attack).

relationships: Technica — controlled her, then turned her into an undead Skylander
Minta Tenjo, Gracie, Euphoria — killed them
Zack and the gas patients — abandoned them
SR Leader — gave him the demons' location
key_quote: Human speed modifications gotta love them right?

name: Technica
role: "Tech", ex Government Tech Squad; freed the gas patients; thought killed in the F2 explosion; Kyle turned her into an undead Skylander weapon; ally.
appearance: Pink hair. Armor outfit (flashback). As Kyle's project: Skylander-DNA wings like Sintrie's (ripped off in Ep 21).

forms.name: Undead Skylander (Kyle's project)
forms.note: Undead corpse with Skylander DNA and Karma; 'Attack Mode'.

skills.name: Heat scanner
skills.description: Scans body heat signatures.

skills.name: Shooting
skills.description: Gun; shoots Minta while chip-controlled.

skills.name: Karma combat
skills.description: Fights Sintrie using the Karma Kyle gave her; killed Hannah.

relationships: Gas patients (Zack, Kaitlyn, Barry, Ava, Persephone) — she freed them
Minta Tenjo — freed her from Kyle's chip
key_quote: If my life will end for caring for others. Yours will end because of your ignorance of the human race!

name: Hannah
role: "Gov girl", Soldier 3523 of F3; ends up protecting SP; killed by Kyle's project.
relationships: Rhalix — threatened her, then promised to protect her
Sintrie, Sam — learn her real name
key_quote: My actual name?.. Nobody asked me that before.. It's Hannah

name: Minta Tenjo
role: Oldest Tenjo sibling; buys time for Yuri and Aniri; killed by Kyle.

skills.name: Hand-to-hand
skills.description: Gets past Kyle's guard and lands a big hit.

skills.name: Mode hijack
skills.description: Figures out Technica's command modes and gets her chip removed.

key_quote: Remember you too, God loves us.

name: Gracie
role: C1 tech at F2; workaholic who used to work in Aurora City; killed by Kyle.
relationships: Yuri — making her a cross necklace
Kyle — tells him about Yuri; killed by him
key_quote: I like you kid, Call me Gracie.

name: Euphoria
role: C1 tech at F2; sees through Kyle; killed by him.
relationships: Yuri — wants to be her big sister
key_quote: Kyle is clearly up to something bad.

name: Kaeru
role: Guardian of the Hekublade ("Heku"), from Recarnet; half fox from Kitsune's last blood; Orenji clan; ally.
appearance: A girl who looks like a fox.

skills.name: Fox Heal
skills.description: Taps Mikiko's chest and restarts his heart; takes a lot of energy.

skills.name: True empathy
skills.description: Copies and clashes Ultima's kick, pushing him back.

skills.name: Fox martial arts
skills.description: Trained 5 years under Kitsune.

skills.name: Heku
skills.description: Can summon the Hekublade herself.

skills.name: Tracking by scent
skills.description: Sniffs out invisible Kyle.

relationships: Kyle — stole the blade from her
key_quote: You're inside the HekuBlade Dumb Dumb now get out of here!

name: Zane
role: "Magical Mage in training", Mikiko's coworker; captured by Ultima and chipped by Kyle; vanishes from a healing pod.

skills.name: Water Magic
skills.description: Weak water attack (Rhalix mocks his form).

skills.name: Elemental change
skills.description: Turns his spilled water into quicksand that traps Rhalix.

weapons: Kyle's chip (he dies if it's removed)
key_quote: Words will not make me free you.
note: Gets weak after using all his Karma.

name: Kyrie
role: Royal of Section 1; leads the Royal Sisters' attack on SR; becomes Queen of Section 1 at 20.
appearance: Wears her mom's old battle uniform with no armor (Ep 22); wears her mom's crown (Ep 25).

skills.name: Kishi
skills.description: Gravity; makes it hard to move.

skills.name: Full Power Kishi
skills.description: Max-power Kishi; doesn't work once Logan and Persephone remove their hoodies.

skills.name: Royal formation 1
skills.description: Team attack with Atherea and Ranrea.

relationships: Queen Loverie (her mom) — captured by SR
Lexy/Persephone — Persephone hates her for killing Ava
key_quote: It's 100% a death plan which is why I have to say this now.

name: Atherea
role: Royal sister; Zack's girlfriend; daughter of Queen Sainea.

skills.name: Earth element
skills.description: Throws dirt in Persephone's eyes; Zack taught her Karma and elements.

key_quote: Welp that's a death plan for ya.

name: Ranrea
role: Oldest Royal sister; sleepy, mixes in Spanish ("Ada"); daughter of Queen Koixea.

skills.name: Tank
skills.description: Gets back up after hits like a tank.

skills.name: Finding hidden places
skills.description: Finds the SR hideout.

skills.name: Throw
skills.description: Sneaks behind Lexy and throws her.

key_quote: Nda, I'm staying with you Kyrie!

name: Lexy / Persephone
role: SP member taken by SR; Persephone, a demon (ex gas patient), takes over her body as "Lexy(Persephone)"; enemy.

forms.name: Lexy(Persephone)
forms.note: Persephone in control of Lexy's body.

skills.name: Power kick
skills.description: Kicks Ranrea down ("It's night night time!").

skills.name: Take over
skills.description: Persephone takes control from Lexy.

relationships: Ava — Persephone's best friend (killed by Kyrie)
Zack, Kaitlyn, Barry — fellow gas patients
key_quote: Maybe if you took some time to learn about Ava you would have been right beside us!

name: Ava
role: Gas patient who became a demon to cure her sickness; Persephone's best friend; later killed by Kyrie (mentioned).

skills.name: Kishi
skills.description: Sintrie says Ava used all her power to take him out with Kishi.

key_quote: Being a demon is great!

name: Logan
role: SR "Skylander Demon" who calls the leader Father; enemy.

skills.name: Thunder flash
skills.description: Lightning strike.

skills.name: Portal
skills.description: Escapes through a portal.

key_quote: Go ahead and take off your Karma Reducing Hoodie Persephone, let's show them the power of SR!

name: Keita
role: SR member; would rather nap.
key_quote: I would rather nap, have someone else go.

name: SR Leader
role: Leader of SR (the Sky Rebellion), called "Father"; gives demons and fallen Skylanders a second chance; wants demons strong enough for possession.

skills.name: Karma freeze
skills.description: Kyle can't move near him; Kyle feels his Karma.

relationships: Kyle — got the demons' location from him
key_quote: That would be called Karma.. A power well known in my world.

role: Ex-assassin turned gas-patient demon who looks human; Ai Oni's student; Atherea's boyfriend; out to kill Kyle.
appearance: Looks human; arrives in a light purple flash.

skills.name: Demon's Eye
skills.description: Learned from his master; finds invisible Kyle.

skills.name: One-hit KO
skills.description: Takes down Persephone with one kick and Logan with one punch ("TIME TO SHOW YOU REAL POWER!!").

skills.name: Damage tank
skills.description: Takes Thunder flash without flinching.

relationships: Persephone, Ava, Barry — fellow gas patients

skills.name: Clone clearing
skills.description: Takes down all the Kyle clones.

skills.name: Demon portal

forms.name: Geo Fox form

skills.name: Knockout
skills.description: Knocks Mikiko out to stop his withdrawals.

key_quote: Last time you were like this it took weeks to fix you.. Oh wait, I know just the person to help.

role: Skylander classmate of Mikiko held hostage by Ultima.
key_quote: Wait, its a trap dont go.

note: Unnamed; only described in Rhalix's narration.
